Independent semantic review — DOCX 0074 R01 / I17A-E02 / official checkbox 081  
Candidate SHA-256: `d5a15e087d7323dd0d9c44191ae26fc0cca6bef052de8af85daa94e621e1f190`  
Review basis: attached packet only; text-only semantic review; visual/layout review not performed or claimed.

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence-linked basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Exact official purpose and genre | PASS | §2.4 quotes the 142-item row (`17,I17A-E02,課程結案報告…`); Table 3 maps document ID 0074, requirement I17A-E02, checkbox 081, indicator 17/17a, evidence page 5; title and §2.1 define the genre as a course closeout report for training administrator/TTQS evaluator use. |
| 2 | Distinction from adjacent 080 and 082 | PASS | §1.3 states 0073 (080) owns post-course satisfaction/multi-stakeholder feedback, while 0074 (081) consumes it and adds plan-vs-delivery, enrollment/attendance/completion, resources/safety, learning check, exceptions, alternatives, and conditional opening recommendation; §17.1 and Table 25 state 0075 (082) is not verified and no follow-up result is claimed. |
| 3 | Dedicated Blueprint coverage: locator, substantive example, result/decision, cross-document facts | PASS | Table 5 is the source/record map with locators and statuses; §§4–9 provide filled SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC substantive content; §§10 and 13 provide findings/decision; §3, Table 5 rows 5/12, and §17 provide cross-document facts including 0073 SHA and 0075 pending status. |
| 4 | Mature, directly usable closeout report and forms | PASS | §§1–17 plus Tables 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 provide a complete closeout report, checklist, and decision form. Table 23 is intentionally a blank real-use decision form, not an evidence gap. |
| 5 | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC vs REAL boundaries; no false approval/execution or third-party proof | PASS | §1.4 negative list; §§2.2–2.3 status vocabulary; Table 2 labels; Tables 1, 22, 24 mark synthetic/unknown status; §15.2 privacy controls; no real names, signatures, approvals, bookings, or quoted third-party opinions are asserted. |
| 6 | Same-case links and numeric facts against exact 0073 excerpt | PASS | §3 and Table 5 row 5 cite DOCX 0073 / I17A-E01 / 080 and case key `SYN-0073-2026-A01`; SHA `a454cf0691a53173ae7838c9cd84522cf419d1d940cb63a7ddc168b497bc9b13` is cited; 16 issued/16 returned/15 valid/1 invalid; S16 missing Q4/Q6/Q7; Q1–Q8 totals, means, and positive counts match the 0073 excerpt; stakeholder IDs T01/H01/M01/M02 are preserved as synthetic. |
| 7 | Recomputation of denominators, percentages, means, completion/schedule/cost arithmetic | PASS | Tables 8, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17, 20, and 27 reconcile: enrollment 16/18 = 88.89%, 16/16 = 100.00%; survey 16/16 = 100.00%, 15/16 = 93.75%, 1/16 = 6.25%; 15×8 = 120, total 479, mean 3.99, positive 90/120 = 75.00%; per-item means/rates as listed; pre 870/16 = 54.38, post 1265/16 = 79.06, change +24.69, ≥80 = 9/16 = 56.25%; budget 5,720 vs 5,440, variance −280 = −4.90%, 5,440/16 = 340; agenda 420−60 = 360 instructional minutes. |
| 8 | Sufficient rejection/hold rules and real-replacement guidance | PASS | §13.3 lists hold/rejection triggers; §16 gives replacement-register steps; Table 24 lists required real replacements and current missing status. |
| 9 | Operable/inspectable by training administrator and evaluator | PASS | §1.2 identifies reader roles; §2.3 defines status terms; Tables 2, 5, 22, 24, and appendices provide locators and forms; review is limited to text, and no visual QA is claimed. |

Overall verdict: **PASS**.

Material gaps identified: **none** against the packet checklist. The candidate preserves the required 0074/081 identity, remains recognizably a closeout report rather than a duplicate survey analysis or standalone improvement list, carries the four Blueprint elements, maintains SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC vs REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD boundaries, matches the 0073 same-case numeric facts, reconciles the shown arithmetic, and provides hold/replacement guidance.

Non-blocking optional improvements (not required for the above verdict):  
- Embed or attach the full replacement register as a table, not only procedural guidance in §16.  
- Add explicit Likert option labels (1–5) alongside the scale statement in §9.2/Table 16.  
- Clarify in Table 4 that the level mapping is illustrative coverage only and is not a claim of TTQS tier attainment.  

Boundary statement: This review assessed semantic/content sufficiency only. It did not assess visual layout, rendering, or page design, and it does not treat any SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC value as a real association record, approval, execution, or third-party proof.
